translations.web: Since you have been precious and honored in my sight, and I have loved you, therefore I will give people in your place, and nations instead of your life.
translations.bsb: Because you are precious and honored in My sight, and because I love you, I will give men in exchange for you and nations in place of your life.
translations.kjv: Since thou wast precious in my sight, thou hast been honourable, and I have loved thee: therefore will I give men for thee, and people for thy life.
translations.asv: Since thou hast been precious in my sight, and honorable, and I have loved thee; therefore will I give men in thy stead, and peoples instead of thy life.
